all_candidates.topic: Should NEET/JEE exam difficulty align with school curriculum?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A government panel draft report this week (August 27, 2026) found a "substantial gap" between school curriculum and the difficulty level of NEET-UG and JEE exams.

all_candidates.topic: Should online exams be instantly re-conducted after glitches?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A technical glitch during a major online entrance exam this week (August 22, 2026) led to calls for re-examination, raising concerns about digital exam reliability.

all_candidates.topic: Should employers mandate a full return-to-office policy?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A major consulting firm reportedly mandated a full return-to-office for all employees this week (August 22, 2026), sparking debate among professionals.

all_candidates.topic: Should airlines be penalized for excessive refund delays?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Customers reported significant delays in receiving refunds from a major airline this week (August 24, 2026), leading to calls for stricter regulations.

all_candidates.topic: Should government launch new digital services after extensive testing?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The rollout of a new unified portal for government services faced initial technical issues this week (August 25, 2026), causing inconvenience to users.

all_candidates.topic: Should e-commerce platforms face harsher penalties for complaints?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The National Consumer Helpline reported nearly 20 lakh complaints against e-commerce platforms this week (August 14, 2026) in the last five years, with non-delivery and wrong products as top issues.

all_candidates.topic: Should food packaging labels provide more extensive details?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Health Ministry proposed new guidelines for food packaging labels this week (August 22, 2026), aiming for more detailed information for consumers.

all_candidates.topic: Are higher traffic fines effective in reducing violations?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New fines for minor traffic violations were implemented in several cities this week (August 25, 2026) to improve road safety and discipline.

all_candidates.topic: Is the IT sector's reduced fresher hiring justified?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Reports this week (August 23, 2026) indicated a slowdown in fresh graduate hiring in the IT services sector due to automation and AI adoption.

all_candidates.topic: Should gig workers receive mandatory minimum wage protection?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A recent study found that gig workers' earnings have stagnated this week (August 23, 2026), reigniting discussions about their rights and protections.

all_candidates.topic: Should companies bear reskilling costs for AI transitions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Nomura report this week (August 25, 2026) analyzing data up to August 2026 indicated that AI adoption is leading to reskilling mandates in many Indian companies.

all_candidates.topic: Will mandatory two-factor UPI authentication improve security?
all_candidates.news_anchor: NPCI announced new UPI guidelines, including mandatory two-factor authentication for digital payments from April 2026, aimed at enhancing security.

all_candidates.topic: Should older vehicles be exempt from E20 fuel mandates?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government recently defended its E20 petrol policy, stating it saved consumers money during a crude price spike, despite concerns about reduced mileage and compatibility with older vehicles this week (August 25, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is UPI's new "delegated payments" feature safe?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The RBI proposed a new "Delegated Payments" feature for UPI this week (August 24, 2026), allowing primary users to authorize secondary users for transactions from their bank accounts.

all_candidates.topic: Will the revamped National Consumer Helpline truly help?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Department of Consumer Affairs revamped the National Consumer Helpline this week (August 24, 2026), offering grievance redressal in 17 languages through multiple channels.

all_candidates.topic: Should state governments prioritize e-buses for public transport?
all_candidates.news_anchor: West Bengal's government this week (August 26, 2026) floated a tender for 400 new environment-friendly buses, including e-buses, to upgrade public transport.

all_candidates.topic: Is expanding free public Wi-Fi feasible nationwide?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government announced plans this week (August 26, 2026) to expand public Wi-Fi hotspots in rural areas across the country.

all_candidates.topic: Are the new GST compliance rules overly strict?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New GST rules for 2026, including a 3-year time bar on return filing and mandatory multi-factor authentication for the GST portal, were highlighted this week (August 3, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Are new digital wallet interoperability rules beneficial?
all_candidates.news_anchor: NPCI introduced new interoperability guidelines for digital wallets this week (August 23, 2026), aimed at enhancing the digital payments ecosystem.

all_candidates.topic: Will new tax exemptions attract global manufacturing?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India is reportedly rewriting its tax rules this week (August 5, 2026) with a proposed bill aiming to offer tax exemptions to foreign companies for manufacturing and offshore funds.
